params.name: toDecrypt
params.description: BLOB to decrypt; overwritten in place with the decrypted data on return.

params.name: sendPubKey
params.description: Sender's public key, generated by the sender with GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR.

params.name: recipPrivKey
params.description: Recipient's private key, generated by the recipient with GENERATE ENCRYPTION KEYPAIR.

overloads.semanticRole: Decrypts a BLOB that was encrypted with ENCRYPT BLOB using the sender's public key (and optionally the recipient's private key), returning the decrypted content in-place in the same BLOB.

constraints: Performs a checksum check to detect BLOB content modification; if the encrypted BLOB is damaged or altered, the command does nothing and returns an error.
